title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据
authors: Ivan Ledezma, Antonia López‐Villavicencio
abstract: We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation. JEL Classification : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。 JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33

title: How Wealth Across the Income Distribution Responds to Uncertainty: Insights from the Distributional Financial Accounts
title_zh: DP21755 收入分配各阶层的财富如何应对不确定性：来自分配金融账户的启示
authors: Lilia Maliar, Christopher Naubert
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use the US Distributional Financial Accounts to assess how wealth across the income distribution responds to uncertainty shocks. Following an uncertainty shock, we find that wealth inequality between those in the top percentile of the income distribution and those in the bottom fortieth percentile of the income distribution declines. We show that the result is driven by systematic differences in portfolio composition between high income and low income individuals, with high income individuals having greater exposure to high risk assets. The response of high risk asset inequality is negative while the response of low risk asset inequality is positive. Therefore, the decline in wealth inequality is due to high income individuals losing more relative to lower income individuals rather than lower income individuals catching up to higher income individuals.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国分配金融账户数据，评估收入分布各阶层的财富如何响应不确定性冲击。研究发现，在不确定性冲击发生后，收入分布前百分位群体与后四十百分位群体之间的财富不平等程度有所下降。这一结果源于高收入与低收入群体在资产组合构成上的系统性差异——高收入群体对高风险资产的敞口更大。高风险资产不平等呈负向响应，而低风险资产不平等呈正向响应。因此，财富不平等的下降并非低收入群体追赶高收入群体所致，而是高收入群体相对损失更大。

title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果
authors: Känzig, Diego R.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general-equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
abstract_zh: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征与高频数据，我识别出碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击推高能源价格、减少排放、刺激绿色创新，但会抑制经济活动——且对贫困家庭造成不成比例的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受到更大影响，其收入损失也更为显著。这些通过收入与就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中发挥重要作用，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。

title: The Big Short (Interest): Closing the Loopholes in the Dividend-Withholding Tax
title_zh: 大空头（空头利息）：堵塞股息预扣税漏洞
authors: Elisa Casi, Evelina Gavrilova, David Murphy, Floris T. Zoutman
abstract: We study the effect of stricter enforcement of the dividend-withholding tax (DWT). We focus on a 2016 Danish enforcement reform and compare Denmark to its Nordic neighbors. Throughout the Nordic stock markets, shares on loan spike sharply around dividend dates. These spikes are consistent with abuse of the DWT system. Postreform, spikes in Denmark disappear, and annual DWT revenue increases by 130 percent. Enforcement does not harm the investment climate as measured by Danish stock returns, investment rate, and dividend yield. (JEL G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了股息预扣税（DWT）执行力度加强的影响。重点关注2016年丹麦的一项执法改革，并将丹麦与其北欧邻国进行比较。在整个北欧股票市场中，股票借贷量在股息发放日前后急剧飙升。这些飙升现象与DWT制度的滥用行为相符。改革后，丹麦的此类飙升现象消失，年度DWT收入增长130%。以丹麦股票回报率、投资率和股息收益率衡量，执法并未损害投资环境。（JEL分类号：G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34）

title: Long-Distance Trade and Long-Term Persistence
title_zh: 长途贸易与长期持续性
authors: Ellingsen, Sebastian
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do changes in the location of trading opportunities cause changes in the location of economic activity? I explore this question using a lifting of restrictions on trade across the Spanish Empire in the 18th century. I combine a difference-in-differences approach with a dynamic spatial model to examine this issue. I find that the reform improved market integration and induced urban growth, but had a smaller effect in locations with larger internal markets. The findings suggest that the location of economic activity adapts to changes in the location of trading opportunities, but persists when these changes are preceded by urban growth.

title: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
title_zh: 无向链接形成博弈中的网络外部性估计
authors: Margherita Comola, Amit Dekel
abstract: This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文探讨了不完全信息链接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性。我们将Leung（2015）的结构估计方法扩展至链接无向且提议仅部分可观测的博弈场景。我们提出了所设计的两步估计量的计量经济学特征，并通过模拟实验验证其性能。将该估计方法应用于坦桑尼亚某村庄风险分担安排的数据后，结果表明间接连接具有显著影响。

abstract: The Arab Spring made evident the dangers of democratization of information for incumbent governments, prompting regulatory changes that helped digital platforms gain power. We document a set of political favors (tariff sparing) for US tech manufacturing in 2018, but the rise of platform revenues does not depend on such favors: digital platforms may benefit from tariffs even when they are not protected and their customers are not protected. In an open economy with ad valorem commissions on the tariff-inclusive consumer price, platform revenue rises with the tariff if and only if demand elasticity is below one in absolute value.

title: When do proxy advisors improve corporate decisions?
title_zh: 代理顾问何时改善公司决策？
authors: Berno Buechel, Lydia Mechtenberg, Alexander F. Wagner
abstract: This paper studies the impact of proxy advisors on shareholder decision‐making. We posit two assumptions: (i) the board is at least as well informed as any individual shareholder; (ii) shareholders can condition their information acquisition on the proxy advisor's (PA) recommendation. If only (i) holds, shareholders optimally rubber‐stamp the board's proposal and do not invest in private research. If (ii) additionally holds, disagreement between the board and the PA can trigger private information acquisition by some shareholders. We identify the conditions under which this mechanism restores value‐of‐information logic and improves the informational quality of shareholder voting outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究代理顾问对股东决策的影响。我们提出两个假设：（i）董事会至少与任何单个股东拥有同等信息；（ii）股东可根据代理顾问（PA）的建议调整其信息获取行为。若仅满足假设（i），股东最优策略是盲目批准董事会提案，且不投入私人研究。若同时满足假设（ii），董事会与代理顾问之间的分歧可能触发部分股东获取私人信息。我们识别了该机制恢复信息价值逻辑并提升股东投票结果信息质量的条件。

title: Market expansion and litigation deterrence effects of patents: Evidence from Chinese exporters
title_zh: 专利的市场扩张与诉讼威慑效应：来自中国出口企业的证据
authors: Xinghua Deng, Ran Jing, John Ries
abstract: Abstract China's overseas patents grew rapidly in the past two decades at the same time as China became the world's largest exporter of merchandise goods. This paper investigates the effects of overseas patents on the volume and prices of Chinese firms' exports. We consider two channels. First, patents prevent imitation and rival entry, leading to higher quantities and prices. Second, patents reduce the likelihood of litigation and can allow firms to price more aggressively if they are keeping prices high to deter potential litigation in the export market. We find evidence of both. Both channels predict a higher quantity of exports, and we find evidence of that in the data. We also compile evidence consistent with patents allowing Chinese firms to price more aggressively (lower prices).
abstract_zh: 摘要 过去二十年，中国海外专利数量快速增长，与此同时，中国成为全球最大的商品出口国。本文研究海外专利对中国企业出口规模与价格的影响。我们考虑两种作用机制：其一，专利阻止模仿与竞争者进入，从而提升出口数量与价格；其二，专利降低诉讼风险，若企业为规避出口市场潜在诉讼而维持高价，则专利可使其采取更激进的定价策略。实证结果支持两种机制的存在。两种机制均预测出口数量增加，数据验证了这一结论。此外，我们发现的证据表明，专利使中国企业能够采取更激进的定价策略（即降低价格）。

title: Fiscal policy divergence
title_zh: 财政政策分化
authors: Piera Bello, Sergio Galletta, Costanza Marconi
abstract: We propose a novel measure of fiscal policy divergence based on public budget data. First, we quantify policy similarity across municipalities based on the cosine similarity of their budget allocations, showing strong correlations with geographic proximity and differences in socio-demographic characteristics. Next, we predict budget similarity out-of-sample using a flexible machine-learning model trained on pairwise differences in local characteristics, defining fiscal divergence as the municipality-year average absolute prediction error. In an empirical application to 8000 Italian municipalities (2000–2015), we show that electoral-cycle patterns are concentrated on the expenditure side of the budget: expenditure divergence is lower in pre-electoral years than in election years, whereas revenue divergence follows a different and less stable pattern.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文基于公共预算数据提出了一种衡量财政政策差异的新方法。首先，我们利用预算分配的余弦相似度量化各市镇间的政策相似性，发现其与地理邻近性及社会人口特征差异存在强相关性。其次，我们采用灵活的机器学习模型，基于地方特征的两两差异对预算相似性进行样本外预测，并将财政差异定义为市镇-年份层面平均绝对预测误差。在对意大利8000个市镇（2000-2015年）的实证分析中，我们发现选举周期模式集中于预算支出端：选举前年份的支出差异低于选举年份，而收入差异则呈现不同且较不稳定的模式。

authors: Dennis Guignet, Anna Silva
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of hedonic studies examining the effects of potable water contamination on home values. We assess the robustness of the results to alternative weights, test for publication bias, and estimate meta-regressions to assess price effect heterogeneity. We find that the adverse effects on home values are similar across public versus private water sources, and that declines in home values persist for more than 10 years, on average. When contamination is detected the average decrease in home values is about 4-5%; and this effect increases to a 12-13% depreciation when contamination levels exceed regulatory or health-based standards. Key Words: benefit transfer, drinking water, groundwater, hedonic, housing value, property value, meta-analysis
abstract_zh: 我们对享乐主义研究中关于饮用水污染对房屋价值影响的相关文献进行了元分析。我们评估了不同权重下结果的稳健性，检验了发表偏倚，并通过元回归分析估计了价格效应的异质性。研究发现，公共水源与私人水源对房屋价值的负面影响相似，且房屋价值平均持续下降超过10年。当污染被检测到时，房屋价值平均下降约4-5%；而当污染水平超过监管或健康标准时，这一影响加剧至12-13%的贬值。关键词：效益转移、饮用水、地下水、享乐主义、住房价值、房产价值、元分析

title: Financial Shocks, Productivity, and Prices
title_zh: 金融冲击、生产率与价格
authors: Simone Lenzu, David Rivers, Joris Tielens, Shi Hu
official: 官方在线 2026-02-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the interconnection between the productivity and pricing effects of financial shocks. Combining administrative records on firm-level output prices and quantities with quasi-experimental variation in credit supply, we show that a tightening of credit conditions has a persistent, yet delayed, negative effect on firms’ long-run physical productivity growth (TFPQ) but also induces firms to change their pricing policies. Commonly used revenue-based productivity measures (TFPR) — which conflate price and productivity — offer biased predictions regarding the consequences of financial shocks for firms’ productivity growth, underestimating the long-run elasticity of physical productivity to credit supply by half. We also show that the pricing adjustments themselves have productivity implications. Firms use low pricing as a source of internal financing, allowing them to avoid cutting expenditures on productivity-enhancing activities, thereby softening the impact of financial shocks. We incorporate these forces into a quantitative model of firm dynamics to quantify the importance of productivity and pricing dynamics (and their interplay) in driving the scarring effects of financial crises on aggregate productivity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融冲击对生产率与定价效应之间的相互关联。通过结合企业层面产出价格与数量的行政记录，以及信贷供给的准实验性变化，我们发现信贷条件收紧对企业长期实物生产率增长（TFPQ）具有持久但滞后的负面影响，同时也会促使企业调整其定价策略。常用的基于收入的生产率指标（TFPR）——混淆了价格与生产率——在预测金融冲击对企业生产率增长的影响时存在偏差，将实物生产率对信贷供给的长期弹性低估了一半。我们还发现，定价调整本身对生产率具有影响。企业将低定价作为内部融资来源，从而避免削减对生产率提升活动的支出，进而缓解金融冲击的影响。我们将这些机制纳入一个企业动态定量模型，以量化生产率与定价动态（及其相互作用）在驱动金融危机对总生产率和福利的疤痕效应中的重要性。

title: Multiple Creditors and Information Rights: Theory and Evidence from US Firms
title_zh: 多个债权人及信息权：来自美国企业的理论与证据
authors: Luigi Guiso, Raoul Minetti
official: 官方在线 2004-03-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyse how a firm allocates information rights across its multiple banks. By differentiating information disclosed, a firm prevents its banks from continuing projects (possibly unsound) solely in order to use their superior information and seize assets during the reorganization. Informational diversity can also lead to the premature liquidation of sound projects, however. We derive the optimal allocation of information as a function of the redeployability and the heterogeneity of the firm?s assets, and of the costs of restructuring the firm in distress. Using a sample of US firms, we find evidence that supports the empirical predictions of the model.
abstract_zh: 本文分析企业如何在其多家银行之间分配信息权。通过区分所披露的信息，企业可防止其银行仅为了利用自身信息优势并在重组期间夺取资产而继续（可能不健全的）项目。然而，信息多样性也可能导致健全项目被过早清算。我们推导出信息的最优分配，该分配取决于企业资产的可重新部署性、异质性以及企业陷入困境时的重组成本。基于美国企业样本，我们发现了支持模型实证预测的证据。
